escena: SCENE (craft macro, no faces, roastery in Santiago, morning): a hard narrow shaft of sunlight cuts across the dark room from a high window and the air inside it is alive with fine floating chaff and dust; a scoop of roasted coffee beans has just been tipped and the beans are FROZEN IN MID-AIR at the top of their arc, each one sharp, tumbling through the beam with their oils catching the light, a faint wisp of warm steam rising behind them. Only the fingers of a hand on the scoop enter at the edge of the frame. 100mm macro lens at f/4, shutter frozen, focus on the beans in flight. Everything is completely unbranded, no brand names, no readable text anywhere.

lecho.objeto: the near edge of the dark roasting table, a hand's width from the lens
lecho.tono: DARK near black, matte, with subtle texture

suspendido: the roasted coffee beans tipped from the scoop
